label: Pass Attempted
currentDefinition: Manual count of pass attempted. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Preserve legacy counter; derive from mutually exclusive pass outcomes in new templates.

label: Pass / Completed
currentDefinition: Intended teammate gains control from the pass, including bank, area and lead passes. Timestamp release.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive pass outcome; do not also increment attempt totals manually.

label: Pass Received
currentDefinition: Manual count of pass received. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Keep after defining one controlled reception and a separate receiver role.

label: Shot Attempt
currentDefinition: Manual count of shot attempt. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Preserve legacy counter; derive once per shot incident including unknown outcome.

label: Shots on target (including goals)
currentDefinition: Count each on-target attempt once, including goals. Do not also add the Goal counter to this aggregate.
recommendation: Preserve current definition; derive goals plus saved shots and display unknown classification.

label: Shot / Goal
currentDefinition: Awarded goal. Timestamp the scoring shot release; attribute the shooting team. A disallowed goal must be corrected. Grade assesses execution, not the score.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive shot outcome; link shooting and goalie viewpoints to one incident.

label: Puck Touch
currentDefinition: Manual count of puck touch. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Define touch versus control episode; use a new ID if changing meaning to puck involvement.

label: Battle / Won
currentDefinition: Our analysis team establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; touching the puck alone is not control.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome distinct from individual credit or coaching grade; include unchanged/unknown.

label: Battle / Lost
currentDefinition: The opponent establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; this does not assign blame to an individual.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome distinct from individual credit or coaching grade; include unchanged/unknown.

label: Possession losses (all causes)
currentDefinition: Count each possession-change incident once across passes, carries and battles. Do not sum this aggregate with its causes.
recommendation: Preserve broad legacy meaning; introduce one verified possession-loss incident with cause.

label: Defense / Takeaway
currentDefinition: Directly dispossess an opponent who controlled the puck. Excludes pass interception and uncontested recovery. Link the same possession-change incident.
recommendation: Keep discrete action with attribution; link related incidents and avoid overlapping possession-gain totals.

label: Defense / Interception
currentDefinition: Gain controlled possession by intercepting an intended opponent pass. A deflection without control is not an interception.
recommendation: Keep discrete action with attribution; link related incidents and avoid overlapping possession-gain totals.

label: Zone Entry
currentDefinition: Manual count of zone entry. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Preserve aggregate counter; derive from crossing outcomes, with denied attempts separately identified.

label: Controlled Zone Entry
currentDefinition: Manual count of controlled zone entry. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Do not infer control from carry/pass method alone; require retained-control context.

label: Zone entries / Dump-in
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by dump. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone Exit
currentDefinition: Manual count of zone exit. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Preserve aggregate counter; derive from crossing outcomes, with denied attempts separately identified.

label: Controlled Zone Exit
currentDefinition: Manual count of controlled zone exit. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Do not infer control from carry/pass method alone; require retained-control context.

label: Check / pressure applied
currentDefinition: Manual combined count of checks or pressure actions. Not an inference of possession gained or good execution.
recommendation: Retain for legacy sessions; prefer distinct pressure, stick-check and body-check definitions.

label: Defense / Shot block
currentDefinition: Defending skater blocks a shot attempt. Excludes blocked passes. Link to the originating shot; timestamp contact.
recommendation: Keep discrete action with attribution; link related incidents and avoid overlapping possession-gain totals.

label: Faceoffs / Won
currentDefinition: Our team establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; this is team outcome, not individual center credit.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome; center involvement is not necessarily official individual credit.

label: Faceoffs / Lost
currentDefinition: Opponent establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; do not infer individual blame.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome; center involvement is not necessarily official individual credit.

label: Time with Puck
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time with puck. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Publish control start/release/loss/whistle/visibility boundaries; distinguish player from team control.

label: Shift Time
currentDefinition: Manual duration of shift time. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Keep as observed shift duration; live-play time on ice requires stoppage and coverage intervals.

label: Time Moving
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time moving. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Specialist only; define motion threshold and camera rule; exclusive with stationary plus unknown.

label: Time Stationary
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time stationary. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Specialist only; no inference from missing visibility; exclusive with moving plus unknown.

label: Time in Offensive Zone
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time in offensive zone. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Specify player or puck location; use exclusive three-zone plus unknown group.

label: Time in Defensive Zone
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time in defensive zone. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Specify player or puck location; add neutral zone and unknown rather than assuming the complement.

label: Time Pressuring Puck Carrier
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time pressuring puck carrier. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Define pressure episode and reset boundary; not automatic possession gain or successful defense.

label: Time Defending Slot
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time defending slot. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Specialist only; define spatial/task rubric and visibility before interpreting duration.

label: Time in Puck Battle
currentDefinition: Manual duration of time in puck battle. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.
recommendation: Define genuine contest start and resolution; link shared incident across participants.

label: Shot / Blocked
currentDefinition: Shot attempt prevented from reaching the net by a defending skater. Link a defensive Shot block to this attempt; timestamp release.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive shot outcome; link shooting and goalie viewpoints to one incident.

label: Shot / Saved
currentDefinition: On-target shot stopped by the goalie, without a goal. Excludes goals and defensive shot blocks. Timestamp release.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive shot outcome; link shooting and goalie viewpoints to one incident.

label: Shot / Missed target
currentDefinition: Shot that does not enter and is not a save or defensive block; includes wide, high, post and crossbar. Timestamp release.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive shot outcome; link shooting and goalie viewpoints to one incident.

label: Shot / Outcome unclear
currentDefinition: A shot attempt is visible but its result cannot be established. Do not infer a result from the grade.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive shot outcome; link shooting and goalie viewpoints to one incident.

label: Pass / Intercepted
currentDefinition: Opponent gains control by intercepting an intended pass. Takes precedence over generic Incomplete. Timestamp release.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive pass outcome; do not also increment attempt totals manually.

label: Pass / Incomplete
currentDefinition: Intended pass does not reach controlled teammate possession and is not an interception. Possession may remain contested or with our team.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive pass outcome; do not also increment attempt totals manually.

label: Pass / Outcome unclear
currentDefinition: Pass attempt is visible but completion/control cannot be established.
recommendation: Keep as exclusive pass outcome; do not also increment attempt totals manually.

label: Battle / No possession change
currentDefinition: A genuine contest ends with the original controlling team retaining control. Do not also label this as a new possession gain.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome distinct from individual credit or coaching grade; include unchanged/unknown.

label: Battle / Unclear
currentDefinition: A puck contest is visible but control at its resolution cannot be established.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome distinct from individual credit or coaching grade; include unchanged/unknown.

label: Defense / Pressure
currentDefinition: Reduce the puck carrier time or options through proximity and positioning. Record consequence separately; pressure need not produce a takeaway.
recommendation: Define one pressure episode and reset boundary; record consequence separately.

label: Defense / Stick check
currentDefinition: Use the stick to challenge the puck or restrict an option. A successful contact need not establish possession.
recommendation: Keep discrete action with attribution; link related incidents and avoid overlapping possession-gain totals.

label: Defense / Body check
currentDefinition: Apply body contact to challenge an eligible opponent under the competition rules. Contact is not inherently positive; record checking rules and consequence.
recommendation: Keep distinct body-check action; competition profile controls availability; contact is not proof of successful defense.

label: Defense / Gap control
currentDefinition: Assess defender distance, angle and speed relative to the attacker at the marked moment. Specify the observed issue in context.
recommendation: Retain as coaching observation; require opportunity rubric for assessment; observation count is not performance quality.

label: Defense / Coverage
currentDefinition: Assess assignment, positioning and lane protection at the marked moment. Do not infer a breakdown cause without evidence.
recommendation: Retain as coaching observation; require opportunity rubric for assessment; observation count is not performance quality.

label: Goalie / Goal Against
currentDefinition: Awarded goal conceded by the observed goalie/team. Timestamp shot release. This result does not establish goalie error.
recommendation: Keep goalie attribution and linked shot; separate technical assessment from result and exclude empty-net goals.

label: Goalie / Save
currentDefinition: The goalie prevents an on-target shot from scoring. Timestamp shot release and link the shot incident; assess rebound disposition separately.
recommendation: Keep goalie attribution and linked shot; separate technical assessment from result and exclude empty-net goals.

label: Goalie / Puck Play
currentDefinition: Goalie handles the puck outside a save: stop a rim, pass, clear, or set the puck. Record action outcome when observed.
recommendation: Keep separate from shots faced; add handling method and retained/lost/unknown outcome.

label: Goalie / Positioning
currentDefinition: Coaching observation of goalie angle, depth, set position, or recovery at the marked instant. Grade only what the view supports.
recommendation: Retain as coaching observation; require opportunity rubric for assessment; observation count is not performance quality.

label: Team Play / Breakout
currentDefinition: Sequence-level observation of recovery, support and puck movement out of the defensive zone. Not an additional discrete zone-exit attempt.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Regroup
currentDefinition: Controlled team reorganization before another attack, usually in the neutral zone. A backward pass alone is not a regroup.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Forecheck
currentDefinition: Coaching observation of coordinated pressure on an opponent breakout. Individual pressure/takeaway records may link to the same sequence.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Backcheck
currentDefinition: Team or player recovery pressure toward the defensive zone; assess positioning and assignment at the marked moment.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Cycle
currentDefinition: Coordinated possession rotation in the offensive zone. A sequence observation, not a new pass count.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Support / outlet
currentDefinition: Off-puck movement or positioning that creates a usable puck-carrier option. Note timing and lane availability.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Screen
currentDefinition: Off-puck positioning that obstructs the goalie view. Record whether the view supports the observation.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Team Play / Net drive
currentDefinition: Off-puck route toward the net that creates space, a passing option or rebound presence. Grade decision/execution separately.
recommendation: Treat as tactical observation/sequence; tag count is not effectiveness or a denominator of opportunities.

label: Penalty / Our penalty
currentDefinition: Penalty assessed to the analysis team. Record the assessed infraction and duration if known; do not infer either from grade.
recommendation: Keep actual assessment, team and duration; opponent penalty does not establish a player drew it.

label: Penalty / Opponent penalty
currentDefinition: Penalty assessed to the opponent. Do not infer which player drew it, or that it was drawn by a player.
recommendation: Keep actual assessment, team and duration; opponent penalty does not establish a player drew it.

label: Penalty / Coincidental penalties
currentDefinition: Linked penalties assessed to both teams on the same incident. Preserve separate assessments in linked notes/events; do not infer strength state.
recommendation: Keep actual assessment, team and duration; opponent penalty does not establish a player drew it.

label: Puck possession / Recovery
currentDefinition: Establish control of an available loose puck without a direct opponent dispossession. Exclude already counted battle resolutions. Timestamp control.
recommendation: Keep precise boundary; exclude overlapping pass or resolved battle outcomes from loss/recovery totals.

label: Puck possession / Controlled carry
currentDefinition: Move while maintaining puck control. Mark the coaching moment; do not count every stride as a new carry.
recommendation: Keep precise boundary; exclude overlapping pass or resolved battle outcomes from loss/recovery totals.

label: Puck possession / Lost control
currentDefinition: Lose controlled possession outside a classified pass or resolved battle. Use notes for reception/carry cause if visible.
recommendation: Keep precise boundary; exclude overlapping pass or resolved battle outcomes from loss/recovery totals.

label: Zone exits / Carry-out
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone exits / Pass-out
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone exits / Clear-out
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by clear. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone exits / Exit denied
currentDefinition: An observable attempt to leave the defensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone entries / Carry-in
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone entries / Pass-in
currentDefinition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Zone entries / Entry denied
currentDefinition: An observable attempt to enter the offensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.
recommendation: Keep method/crossing outcome; capture retained control, denied intent and recovery separately.

label: Faceoffs / Undetermined
currentDefinition: The draw occurs but resulting team control cannot be established.
recommendation: Keep team-control outcome; center involvement is not necessarily official individual credit.

label: Stoppages / Icing
currentDefinition: Icing called under the competition rules. Attribute offending side if known; do not infer a pass attempt or turnover.
recommendation: Keep actual call and offending side where known; do not infer turnover or player blame.

label: Stoppages / Offside
currentDefinition: Offside called under the competition rules. Link the entry attempt if known.
recommendation: Keep actual call and offending side where known; do not infer turnover or player blame.

label: Stoppages / Puck out of play
currentDefinition: Play stops because the puck leaves the playing area. Do not infer delay-of-game without an assessed penalty.
recommendation: Keep actual call and offending side where known; do not infer turnover or player blame.

label: Stoppages / Puck covered / frozen
currentDefinition: Play stops because the puck is covered or frozen. Link a goalie save when applicable; not an extra shot.
recommendation: Keep actual call and offending side where known; do not infer turnover or player blame.

label: Stoppages / Other whistle
currentDefinition: Other observable stoppage. Describe the reason in notes; leave unknown when the footage does not establish it.
recommendation: Keep actual call and offending side where known; do not infer turnover or player blame.
